impact: A sharp memory selloff in Seoul a day before Nvidia earnings points to a weak open for MU, DRAM and SNXX; SKM's SK hynix exposure is also hit. A strong Nvidia guide Tuesday is the main thing that could reverse it.
summary: The Kospi closed down 3.59% at about 5,100 on Monday as foreigners sold about 1.7 trillion won of Korean shares. SK hynix fell 7.89% to 1.12 million won and Samsung Electronics 4.47% to 196,800 won, while the Kosdaq dropped 4.86%. Reports tie the selloff to uncertainty over the AI ecosystem after Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia, with one report also citing falling NAND spot prices.
title: Kospi falls 3.6% as SK hynix sinks 7.9%, Samsung 4.5%
